steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and participant controls are available.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet required for the RFQ create flow.
Commit a valid event schedule before inviting the vendor.
Search for and add the specifically named vendor, testing that product mapping does not prevent the addition.
Verify that the unmapped vendor appears on the participant area after being added.
